name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Remote updater hardening, compatibility reporting, update log, and detailed error logs.
notes: Remote update checks and downloads now support http, https, file URLs, plain local paths, and Windows absolute paths.
Downloaded ZIPs are verified by SHA256, size, safe extraction paths, and embedded release_manifest.json version.
Compatibility output now distinguishes local patcher support from the support list declared by the remote manifest.
Detailed error logs include admin state, platform, argv, release manifest, update config, and key environment variables.
